name: GPU Graphics Drivers
shortDesc: Essential graphics drivers (Required for archinstall Minimal profile)
detailedDesc: Because archinstall's Minimal profile does not include GPU drivers, you must select your hardware driver here so your display server or Wayland compositor can render.

phase.title: Base & Architecture
phase.description: Core display server protocols, desktop architecture paradigms, and package manager helpers.

packages.name: Intel Graphics (Integrated HD/UHD/Iris & Arc)
packages.description: Standard open-source Mesa driver with Vulkan and hardware VA-API video decoding for Intel integrated and discrete Arc graphics.
pros: Low power consumption and efficient hardware video decode
cons: Older GMA chipsets (Gen 3/4) lack Vulkan support

packages.name: AMD Radeon Graphics
packages.description: Standard AMDGPU open-source stack with RADV Vulkan and Mesa VA-API acceleration for modern and legacy Radeon cards.
pros: Best-in-class Linux driver with zero proprietary blobs
cons: Very old TeraScale cards (HD 5000/6000) require legacy radeon module

packages.name: NVIDIA Proprietary (DKMS)
packages.description: Official proprietary NVIDIA driver compiled via DKMS for current GeForce GTX 900+ / RTX cards. Injects Wayland environment variables.
pros: Maximum 3D graphics, CUDA, and gaming performance
cons: Explicit sync setup needed on Wayland

packages.name: NVIDIA Open Kernel Modules (Turing+ / RTX)
packages.description: NVIDIA's open-source kernel modules for Turing, Ampere, Ada Lovelace, and newer GPUs (RTX 2000 series and up).
pros: Open kernel modules integrated with Linux ecosystem
cons: Not compatible with GTX 1000 series or older hardware

packages.name: Virtual Machine (QEMU / KVM / VirtualBox)
packages.description: Optimized guest drivers and clipboard/resolution synchronization daemons for running Arch inside a VM.
pros: Dynamic window resizing and seamless clipboard sharing
cons: No direct bare-metal 3D GPU acceleration without PCIe passthrough

packages.name: Skip / Generic Mesa Software Rasterizer
packages.description: Install basic Mesa LLVMpipe software rasterizer without hardware-specific acceleration (useful for troubleshooting or custom setups).
cons: High CPU usage for any graphical rendering
